admission.justification: Spans every host launch surface: the bearing rule (speed choices accepted, permission-bearing refused unless authorized, unknown refused) is the filter FAM-N17BB4's launch-choice guarantee depends on — without it the family could carry an unauthorized choice onto the create call.

applicability: Every host feature value presented for launch acceptance.
conditions: The host names the feature's availability for the selected provider and model.
The value's actual field meaning (speed vs permission-bearing vs unknown) is established.
exclusions: Values whose bearing is unknown, which are refused.
Permission policy, which stays distinct from speed controls.
statement: Host feature availability and actual field meaning govern acceptance: service_tier/fast_mode and serviceTier are speed choices; plan_mode/auto_accept are permission-bearing; unknown bearing is refused.
